name: pmfby_authenticate_farmer
description: Authenticates a farmer using Aadhaar and OTP. Requires a valid Aadhaar registered in the system. Aadhaar must be exactly 12 digits, mobile 10 digits, and OTP 6 digits. Returns a session_token and farmer profile summary. Does not create a new farmer registration. Fails if OTP is incorrect or expired.

otp.description: 6-digit one time password sent to the mobile number [EXACT]

name: pmfby_check_enrollment_window
description: Checks if the enrollment window is open for a specific state, district, and season. Requires no prior state initialization. Season must be a valid enum and year must be a 4-digit integer. Returns enrollment_window_status and cut-off dates. Does not check individual farmer eligibility. Fails if state or district codes are invalid.

name: pmfby_get_notified_crops
description: Retrieves the list of notified crops eligible for insurance in a given district and season. Requires no prior state initialization. Year must be a 4-digit integer. Returns a list of crop names, scale of finance, and premium rates. Does not calculate actual premium amounts for specific land areas. Fails if no crops are notified for the specified combination.

name: pmfby_calculate_premium
description: Calculates the estimated premium amount and sum insured for a specific crop and land area. Requires the crop to be in the notified crops list for the district. Area must be greater than 0 hectares. Returns farmer_premium_amount, government_subsidy, and total_sum_insured. Does not submit an enrollment application or deduct funds. Fails if the crop is not notified or area exceeds maximum limits.

crop_name.description: Name of the crop to be insured [SUBSTRING]

name: pmfby_validate_land_records
description: Validates farmer land area against state revenue records. Requires no prior state initialization. Survey number must follow state-specific alphanumeric formats. Returns verified_area_hectares and owner_name. Does not update land records in the state database. Fails if the survey number is not found or if the land is already fully insured by another farmer.

survey_number.description: Khasra or survey number of the land [EXACT]

name: pmfby_submit_enrollment_application
description: Submits a crop insurance enrollment application for a notified crop. Requires an authenticated session, enrollment_window_status must be open, and land records must be validated. Area must be greater than 0 and match validated land records. Returns an application_id and application_status. Does not process premium payment. Fails if enrollment window is closed, crop is not notified, or duplicate enrollment exists for the same crop and season.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private enrollment and claim data [TYPE_ONLY]

crop_name.description: Name of the crop to be insured [SUBSTRING]

survey_number.description: Khasra or survey number of the land [EXACT]

name: pmfby_get_application_status
description: Retrieves the current status of a submitted PMFBY enrollment application. Requires a valid application_id generated from a prior submission. application_id must be a valid alphanumeric string. Returns application_status, policy_status, and payment_status. Does not allow modification of the application. Fails if the application_id does not exist in the system.

name: pmfby_download_enrollment_certificate
description: Retrieves the digital enrollment certificate for an approved application. Requires an authenticated session, application_status must be enrolled, and policy_status must be active. application_id must belong to the authenticated farmer. Returns certificate_url and policy_number. Does not generate certificates for rejected or pending applications. Fails if policy_status is not_issued or cancelled.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private enrollment and claim data [TYPE_ONLY]

name: pmfby_submit_claim
description: Submits a crop loss claim for a notified crop under an active insurance policy. Requires an authenticated session, policy_status must be active, and claim must be within the cut-off window after the loss event. Date of loss must be in the past and within the active season. Returns a claim_id and initial claim_status. Does not handle loss assessment or surveyor assignment. Fails if no active policy exists, if the loss reason is not covered, or if the claim is filed after the 72-hour reporting window.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private enrollment and claim data [TYPE_ONLY]

loss_event_type.description: Type of calamity causing the crop loss [EXACT]

date_of_loss.description: Date when the crop loss occurred in YYYY-MM-DD format [EXACT]

loss_description.description: Brief description of the crop damage [SUBSTRING]

name: pmfby_get_claim_status
description: Retrieves the current processing status of a submitted crop loss claim. Requires a valid claim_id from a previously filed claim. claim_id must be a valid alphanumeric string. Returns claim_status, assessment_remarks, and estimated_completion_date. Does not provide final compensation amounts if status is under_survey. Fails if the claim_id is invalid or not found.

claim_id.description: Unique PMFBY crop loss claim identifier [TYPE_ONLY]

name: pmfby_get_surveyor_assignment
description: Retrieves the details of the surveyor assigned to assess a localised crop loss claim. Requires claim_status to be filed or under_survey, and calamity_scope must be localised. claim_id must be valid. Returns surveyor_name, contact_number, surveyor_assignment_status, and scheduled_visit_date. Does not assign or reassign surveyors. Fails if calamity_scope is widespread or if surveyor assignment is pending.

claim_id.description: Unique PMFBY crop loss claim identifier [TYPE_ONLY]

name: pmfby_get_compensation_details
description: Retrieves the calculated compensation amount and disbursement details for an approved claim. Requires an authenticated session, and claim_status must be assessed, approved, or disbursed. claim_id must belong to the authenticated farmer. Returns compensation_amount, compensation_status, utr_number, and credit_date. Does not initiate the actual bank transfer. Fails if claim_status is rejected or if threshold yield was not met.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private enrollment and claim data [TYPE_ONLY]

claim_id.description: Unique PMFBY crop loss claim identifier [TYPE_ONLY]

name: pmfby_raise_grievance
description: Submits a grievance regarding an enrollment issue, claim rejection, or delayed compensation. Requires an authenticated session and prior retrieval of the related application or claim status. Grievance category must be a valid enum value. Returns a grievance_id and expected_resolution_date. Does not immediately resolve the dispute or alter claim status. Fails if the grievance description is too short or if a duplicate grievance is already open for the same reference ID.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private enrollment and claim data [TYPE_ONLY]

reference_id.description: Related application_id or claim_id for the grievance [TYPE_ONLY]

name: pmfby_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks the resolution status of a previously submitted grievance. Requires a valid grievance_id. grievance_id must be a valid alphanumeric string. Returns grievance_status, resolution_remarks, and action_taken. Does not allow reopening a closed grievance. Fails if the grievance_id does not exist.

grievance_id.description: Unique identifier for the submitted grievance [TYPE_ONLY]

name: pmfby_get_district_loss_notifications
description: Retrieves active widespread calamity notifications for a specific district and season. Requires no prior state initialization. Season must be a valid enum. Returns a list of notified loss events, affected crops, and calamity_scope. Does not file individual claims for farmers. Fails if state or district names are unrecognized.

name: pmfby_cancel_enrollment_application
description: Cancels a submitted enrollment application before premium payment is processed. Requires an authenticated session, and application_status must be submitted or not_submitted. application_id must belong to the authenticated farmer. Returns cancellation_confirmation and updated application_status. Does not refund premiums if payment has already been processed. Fails if application_status is premium_paid or enrolled, or if the enrollment window is closed.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private enrollment and claim data [TYPE_ONLY]
